correctness.rationale: The harmonic monomial basis is orthonormal with gamma moments, giving a bilateral step-m shift. The reflection of weights proves signed pairing, while strict log-convexity proves all c_k>0. Two-term gamma-ratio expansions give c_k=m²(alpha+1)k^-2+O(k^-3) and the sorted s_n limit; finite telescoping gives the exact trace norm. Moment derivatives establish monotonicity; rational unweighted formulas establish the operator norm. Exact and high-precision supplementary verifier passed 29,580 finite checks; infinite results are proved analytically.
